verdict.rationale: A community-sourced excerpt of Morph's privacy policy (morph-comm-6) shows Enterprise Tier users can opt out of having code/data used for training, satisfying the story, but Free Tier data is explicitly used to train models by default — a significant caveat requiring a paid tier to actually prevent training use. No first-party Morph docs in the evidence pack directly address data retention/training opt-out. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the privacy/data-use policy and opt-out mechanism, independent confirmation that Enterprise-tier exclusion is honored in practice.
